newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HORIZON SEEKS HELP FOR ANTI-CANCER PRODUCT.
newsitem.headline: HORIZON SEEKS HELP FOR ANTI-CANCER PRODUCT.

text.p: Hungarian R&D company Horizon-Multiplan said on Thursday it was seeking financial and professional help to proceed with its initial experiments to treat cancer by humic acid.

"Horizon-Multiplan owns a new scientific invention which... can be the starting point of significant process in certain areas of medical science," Csaba Elek, Horizon-Multiplan's CEO told a news conference.
"Humic acid, the active ingredient of Humet-R (Horizon's product), has proven effective against tumours in animal experiments as preventive and curative agent," he said.
Experiments on animals showed that as a preventive mean, the product was beneficial for strong smokers, alcoholists and for people exposed to radiation.
In treatment Humet was expected to hinder the increase of tumour and to reduce the chance of recur of the tumour, Horizon said in a statement.

"According to our information Humet is the first material which hinders the building of tumours indirectly, by increasing the protective power of the human body," it said, without specifying against which form of cancer it was seen efficient.
Humet has been launched in Slovakia, the Ukraine, Ireland, Taiwan and the United Kingdom, as paramedical product.

The company said it has received requests for joint production from Japan, China, Russia and the Ukraine. Horizon said its main trade partner, Ireland's Cross Vetpharm Ltd, was considering the local production of the Humet syrup.
Horizon's main shareholders is Switzerland-based Hofmann Schneider Capital S.A. with an around 30 percent stake.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Horizon's shares closed at 300 forints, up one.
